name: sequence-stats
description: FASTA validation and deterministic sequence statistics (existing smartbio engine).

tools.name: FASTA Validator
tools.description: FASTA structure and IUPAC alphabet validation.

references.title: Nomenclature for incompletely specified bases in nucleic acid sequences: recommendations 1984
references.verified_by: CrossRef metadata for DOI 10.1093/nar/13.9.3021 (Cornish-Bowden, Nucleic Acids Research 13(9):3021-3030, 1985), checked 2026-11-24

limitations: Validation checks FASTA structure and alphabet only; it does not assess sequencing quality or biological correctness.
Ambiguity codes are interpreted with the IUPAC 1984 recommendation; the alphabet must be chosen explicitly.
Inline FASTA text is capped at 64 KiB by the Worker transport contract.

tools.name: Sequence Statistics
tools.description: FASTA validation plus per-record statistics and collection summaries (length, GC%, composition, N50).

references.title: Nomenclature for incompletely specified bases in nucleic acid sequences: recommendations 1984
references.verified_by: CrossRef metadata for DOI 10.1093/nar/13.9.3021 (Cornish-Bowden, Nucleic Acids Research 13(9):3021-3030, 1985), checked 2026-11-24

references.title: Smart Bioinformatics Toolkit: DNA GC percentage definition

limitations: Statistics include valid, non-empty records only.
DNA GC percentage uses canonical A/C/G/T bases as its denominator; ambiguous bases are excluded.
N50 and composition describe only the supplied records; they are not assembly quality measures.
FASTA input does not contain per-base sequencing quality scores.
